description: This file defines the UserSettingsImplementation class, which implements user settings management, notification handling, and configuration for a plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for setting and getting various user preferences, managing notifications, and handling events related to user settings.

classes.name: UserSettingsImplementation
classes.description: Implements user settings management, notification handling, and configuration for the plugin, including methods for setting/getting preferences, managing notifications, and handling events.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: A nested class that implements the notification interface for store value changes, forwarding events to the parent UserSettingsImplementation.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class used for handling asynchronous events related to user settings changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for user settings changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio description preference.

methods.name: SetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Sets the preferred closed captioning service.

methods.name: GetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Gets the preferred closed captioning service.

methods.name: SetLiveWatershed
methods.description: Sets the live water shed setting.

methods.name: GetLiveWatershed
methods.description: Gets the live water shed setting.

methods.name: SetPlaybackWatershed
methods.description: Sets the playback water shed setting.

methods.name: GetPlaybackWatershed
methods.description: Gets the playback water shed setting.

methods.name: SetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Sets whether to block not rated content.

methods.name: GetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Gets the block not rated content setting.

methods.name: SetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Sets the PIN on purchase setting.

methods.name: GetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Gets the PIN on purchase setting.

methods.name: SetHighContrast
methods.description: Enables or disables high contrast mode.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Enables or disables voice guidance hints.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Gets the voice guidance hints status.

methods.name: GetMigrationState
methods.description: Checks if a specific setting requires migration.

methods.name: GetMigrationStates
methods.description: Retrieves migration states for all settings.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the given service.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event with given parameters.
